title: Deaths in the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign
reading: An estimated 250,000, with the total uncertain
basis: This describes the subsequent 1942 campaign, not deaths on 18 April or a count of people who directly helped airmen. No raid-day timestamp is assigned.

records.says: Estimates a quarter-million deaths; documents massacres, destruction and biological warfare.
Attributes 250,000 to Chiang Kai-shek and Chennault; says the real total is unknown.
